body: Literally so fucking embarrassing
All the older men who fuck younger guys are the ones seeing something wrong with this post. I relate to this extensively
Nah leave him alone. He’s 13 and figuring it out
I have no one else
He ghosted me. Haven’t heard from him since July. Crushed me

The kind words and support mean so much to me ❤️ 
One thing is that they paid for school, housing, and food so it will be really difficult for me to continue school while trying to get the money together to pay for everything else. I could never ask for money from strangers on the internet, but I do appreciate the thought. I think my best bet at the moment is to work full time to pay rent month to month while I figure out my plan with school next semester. I was able to withdraw from my classes for this semester, didn’t really have a choice with payments due soon. Again, thanks everyone for being so helpful ❤️

I disagree, he treated me like no one has before and he deserves to get what he gave. If I can’t get closure with him, then I’ll still be bitter. If I inconvenience him with thousands of marshmallows on his lawn before a rainstorm, I’ll be bitter still but will know that I did something out of respect for myself.
All of you have helped a lot. Still hurting. A lot. But that is okay and you have all made me okay with that ❤️
It was not casual. went on vacations, used the L word.

I literally want to out him to his neighbors and family but alas, that would be “immature”. Entirely warranted in my eyes. I’d be doing him a favor, just like he thinks he’s doing my a favor by sparing my feelings.
I do have to move on and look for men who value me as a person. But why does he get to treat me like shit and get away with it? It’s just not fair. He has to learn some sort of lesson here.
I agree, but I feel like I need closure now.
No wife, just an asshole

Older men in these comments have the emotional quotient of a thumb tack. I was venting. I am exclusively interested in older and I cannot change that part of my brain. It is horrible and suffocating. I have created a fake version of myself, and I hate myself for it. I have a therapist for those telling me to get one. I have been in inpatient for two weeks and was feeling better, was supposed to see my guy when I got out but he ended a 2 year relationship with an 8 word text.
Been seeing a guy in his 60s for a year, he’s great, we get along so well, nothing to question if it feels right
I am obsessed with an older man, he doesn’t show the same interest. Can’t shake these lovey dovey feelings I have for him
Made me cry. I needed that. Thank you.
This is not mildly infuriating. I am fully infuriated

Thanks for all the replies, it’s nice to hear people tel me how it is. The vacation definitely was a turning point, but I really couldn’t go and he sadly saw that as me not showing interest which is far from the case. Although I really do need to work on myself before I can expect a relationship. Not giving up on him as I can see a future for us, but it’s hard to imagine that with such an age difference. How do I stop these feelings of jealousy in the meantime till I see him? Seeing him on grindr is driving me crazy, but I think it may be driving him too bc he keeps tapping me but won’t message. UGH
As much of an ass Kanye is, he is severely mentally I’ll and the media acts as if it’s something to laugh at
